lokele: Imi Paulo, boto wa Masiya Yesu oyakandomu bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, la etungani yasu ako Timoteo,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ 1:1 Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

lokele: tosotoma lokasa-lo ende Filemona bokuwani lasu wa losamɔ, la ende welo wasu w’Etanda ako Apia, la ende Alikipo bosilikani lasu nda bita-bi, la ende eb’Etanda ebatosɔngɔkɔmɔ nda ndakɔ yaɛ, Filemona.
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

lokele: Booto end’ino la lilatemi lia Mungu Sango wasu la elia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya! Kelekele la lisomboli lia Paulo eoka ya Filemona
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Itofaekefa Mungu kelekele mbile bitotina ani itosingwaka baina banu nda basomboli bami,
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

lokele: eoka isokaka loasɔ loa losamɔ la lilendelu elile laɛ ende Ngɛnɛ Yesu la ende ebüchomu batotina bande;
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

lokele: la isosombola mbo lisanganesi lia lüendelu liaɛ liɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ nda liluwani lia bitotina bilau yanu ebile ya Masiya.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Eoka yende la limɛngɔ la botema bosoaa se eoka ya losamɔ loaɛ, mbo betema ya eba Masiya bisoyaimwaka ko eoka yaɛ, etungani. Loasɔ loa Onesimo oyayalaka bɔkɔwa wa Filemona
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

lokele: Eokao, ango yetendela finɛ ndotel’aɛ ekela nda lina lia Masiya mbo oondu nde ndokela kwa atoonga’mi,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

lokele: kongo ko isɔlɛmbɛ ndolɔmbɔkɔl’aɛ eoka ya losamɔ; Imi Paulo, wange finɛ la imɔ boto wa Masiya Yesu oyale kwani nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ko l’eoka yande,
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

lokele: ikolɔmbɔkɔl’aɛ loasɔ loa ewami wana ako Onesimo oyasoota’mi oot’inde onomono nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains, 1:10

lokele: Oso Onesimo atiaaka bosungi waɛ, nde kwani ale bosungi bolau waɛ, la ewami lisanga.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

lokele: Isoinol’inde end’aɛ kwa mbo isotomel’aɛ botema wami angɛnɛ.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

lokele: Ko’mi angɛnɛ, ani isosanga ndotikala lande ono eyami, mbo akuweleke’mi loasɔ loaɛ angɛnɛ, ono ayali’mi nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eoka ya Mboli Ilau;
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

lokele: nde itilɛmbɛkɛ ndokela loasɔ angolɔmɔi sakolo ngo ko ani aɛ nd’aluwi oso, mbo booto waɛ botatinjakomo, kangä ko l’eoka ya lisangi liaɛ angɛnɛ.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

lokele: Eluwa ko la litina-li asɛnyanɛsɔmɔkɔ laɛ ko mbile sinyo, mbo oyaleke lande layalaya,
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

lokele: nde inga imɔ kwa bɔkɔwa, kangä ndolongela bɔkɔwa, kwa etungani oyasamomu lami finɛ, nde simbi to laɛ, loasɔ loasu balomboki la eoka ya Ngɛnɛ wasu.
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

lokele: Eokao, botanga’mi mbo lisaɔ liaɛ, aɛ koael’inde kwa mbo waeli nde’mi angɛnɛ.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

lokele: Eyambo akeelak’aɛ loasɔ lobe, la eyala la bolima waɛ, taka to wao nda lokasa loami;
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

lokele: Imi Paulo nd’asosɔnɔ la bosamba wami angɛnɛ mbo— Imi itokamba. Itaonga laɛ mbo wende imɔ la bolima woeta ende’mi, boko liwawi liaɛ angɛnɛ.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

lokele: Eingo, etungani, yɔlɛkɛ sumbu bondanda end’aɛ nda likuwa lia Ngɛnɛ wasu; yaimwesaka botema wami eoka ya Masiya.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’aɛ ongoma eoka isolendelo lilitesi liaɛ la eoka isoluwa mbo otokela ambo loasɔ lolongela elosoonga’mi.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

lokele: Tonjelak’imɔ imi ndakɔ yoingala, eoka iɛli shami sile mbo yeinolomoko end’ino ko l’eoka ya basomboli banu. Baseeli ba baina ba Paulo ende Filemona
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

lokele: Epafula oyale amamwito lami nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eoka ya Masiya Yesu, asoseel’aɛ,
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

lokele: la Malako la Alisitaluka la Dema la Luka basungani lami nda likuwa.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

lokele: Booto wa Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya boyaleke la belimo yanu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
